decisions.statement: A provider token is signed once and used again for fifty minutes.
One connection to Apple is opened and kept for every later send.
A connection that errored or closed is opened again on the next send.
A 410 answer or a bad device token marks that token to be dropped.
Any other answer short of 200 is an error the caller is handed.
A send Apple has not answered inside twenty seconds is ended rather than awaited.
With the signing key unset no sender is made at all.
The reason no sender was made is handed back to the caller.
Nothing here decides who a push goes to.

definition: one alert handed to Apple's push service over a connection kept open
